title: Comparative analysis of the performance of large language models in answering endodontics questions on the dental specialty exam

live_model.evidence: 'compare the accuracy of ChatGPT (GPT-5), Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Pro), and Grok (SuperGrok) on Dental Specialty Exam (DUS) endodontics questions'; 'Overall accuracy was...85.8% (109/127) for ChatGPT'

prompt.note: 'Questions were submitted to each model using default settings with one response per item'; exam questions themselves are not reprinted.

data.source: Turkish ÖSYM Dental Specialty Exam (DUS) endodontics questions, 2012-2021 (proprietary national licensing exam)

notes: 'ChatGPT (GPT-5)' is not confirmed as the pinned gpt-5-2025-08-07 snapshot (no API/version detail given, and this genre of paper typically uses the consumer web app). A separate GPT-4-Turbo mention elsewhere in the paper (via 'Copilot Pro (GPT-4 Turbo)') is a citation to a different cited study, not this paper's own experiment.
